Author: syberdamon
Name: Combat Recorder
Description: Writes one compressed JSON-lines file per duty: every action you, your party and enemies use (with damage/heal numbers), buffs and debuffs gained and lost, HP/MP and positions twice a second, casts, deaths and target changes. Party members are recorded by job and slot, never by name. /crec mark <note> drops a marker you can point to later ("downtime here"). Nothing leaves your PC.
Punchline: Records your fights (actions, damage, heals, buffs, HP, movement) to compact local files for review.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Cooldown Grid
Description: Pick any of your job's cooldown abilities and sort them into groups. Each group gets its own window: a grid of ability icons showing time remaining and charges. Click an icon to use the ability, just like a hotbar button. Settings are saved per job; All four tanks ship with a starter layout.
Punchline: Clickable cooldown grids, grouped into Defensive (self), Defensive (group), Support, and your own groups.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Map Click Nav
Description: Hold a modifier (Ctrl by default) and left-click a spot on any zone's map. Map Click Nav places your flag there, teleports to the nearest attuned aetheryte if that's faster (always, for another zone), mounts with Mount Roulette, and has vnavmesh fly you there if flight is unlocked (or ride there if not). A Stop button appears while traveling. Requires vnavmesh.
Punchline: Ctrl+click any map to teleport, mount, and fly there with vnavmesh.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Materia Manager
Description: Shows your materia by type and grade in your bags, saddlebag and materia retainer. Storage: opening the saddlebag stores bag materia; "pull all" brings it back for transmuting; your materia retainer is topped up to a minimum/maximum of each materia (e.g. 800) when you open it, splitting stacks for exact amounts, and the rest stays in your bags. Transmutation: pick fodder and keep-at-least numbers; it plans batches of five and takes you to Mutamix Bubblypots. English client.
Punchline: Materia in one place: auto-store to saddlebag or retainer, and plan transmutation batches with keep-at-least rules.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Material Stash
Description: Sorts common crafting materials onto your retainers in the order you choose. Gathered materials (mining, botany, fishing) and white, tradeable mob drops used in recipes qualify; boss drops, crafted items and collectables don't, and you can include or exclude anything by hand. Each category (ore, lumber, hides...) gets an ordered list of home retainers, with an overflow order behind it, and items already on a retainer are kept together. Crystals fill retainers in the game's list order, keeping a set amount of each on you. Nothing runs by itself: press "Stash" above the retainer list (after AutoRetainer is done) and it visits each retainer, deposits, and moves on. Stock list: keep a minimum and target of items, or of whole recipes (materials worked out from the recipe); when AutoRetainer sends a retainer out, it is sent for the most-needed item it can bring back. Tidy sorts items between retainers by groups (housing, gear, materials...), name rules and item pins. Keep on me protects what you carry. When nothing on the stock list fits a retainer, it can go for what sells best on your home world instead (with a demand check); those items stay in your bags, boxed, and can be listed automatically. A Clean-up tab goes through everything on your retainers and suggests what to sell, vendor, turn in, desynthesize, learn, keep for its look or discard (judged by value, the glamour dresser and Armoire, and how easy it is to get again), then carries out what you approve. A small window counts ready ventures. Buttons on the saddlebag move mats in or out. English client.
Punchline: One button at the summoning bell puts your gathered and mob-dropped crafting mats and crystals on the right retainers.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Mit Planner
Description: Detects your duty, runs the fight's timeline (cactbot format, synced to the boss's actual abilities), and shows the next mechanics with countdowns and type (tank buster, raid-wide, ...). Attach your cooldowns to specific mechanics per job, and get a callout a few seconds before each one. Optional per-cooldown auto-use. Ships with every fight cactbot has a timeline for (300+ dungeons, trials, raids and ultimates, refreshed weekly), with tank busters and raid-wides pre-tagged.
Punchline: Boss timeline with countdowns, plus a per-job cooldown plan that tells you what to press and when.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Poetics Spender
Description: Pick a topsoil (Thanalan or Shroud). One click teleports you to Idyllshire, buys Unidentifiable Ore/Shell from Hismena with all your Poetics (150 each), and trades it to Bertana for Grade 3 topsoil. A movable alert pops up when your Poetics reach a threshold (1800 by default); click it to run. Requires vnavmesh. English client.
Punchline: Turn your Poetics into Grade 3 topsoil with one click, plus a near-cap alert.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Raise Callouts
Description: Watches your own raise spells (Raise, Resurrection, Ascend, Egeiro, Verraise, Angel Whisper) and posts a callout when you start casting one, or when an instant (Swiftcast/Dualcast) raise lands. Works with rotation plugins because it watches the cast itself, not a hotbar button. One message per raise, skips targets already being raised, editable message, party chat or echo only.
Punchline: Says "Raising <name>" in party chat whenever you raise someone, however it was cast (RotationSolver, macros, hotbar).

Author: syberdamon
Name: Rescue Helper
Description: Asks BossMod (Reborn) which spots are dangerous right now and checks each party member's position. Anyone standing in a danger zone that resolves within a few seconds turns red with a countdown. Click their row to Rescue them, or switch to automatic. It only Rescues when your own spot is safe, Rescue is ready and in range, and never pulls a tank holding enemies or a player carrying a mechanic marker (spread/stack). Needs BossMod or BossMod Reborn.
Punchline: Healers: a party panel that shows who's standing in an AoE about to go off. Click to Rescue them, or let it Rescue automatically.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Retainer Gear
Description: Records each retainer's equipped gear when you open them, then works out the highest item level available for their job and level from crafted gear, dungeon drops and uncapped-tomestone gear (no raid or savage gear). Shows what each retainer still needs, a combined shopping list with market board prices (Universalis) for crafted pieces, and marks gear you already own and which retainer it's for. Re-check after you equip upgrades and the list updates.
Punchline: Tracks your retainers' gear and lists the best non-raid upgrades: crafted, dungeon drops, or uncapped tomestones.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Tank Stance Manager
Description: MT mode keeps tank stance on at all times. OT mode toggles tank stance to hold your enmity inside a configurable band of the main tank's enmity (default 75%-90%), and turns it on if you are pushed to #3. Supports PLD, WAR, DRK, GNB.
Punchline: Keeps tank stance on as MT, or holds an enmity band as OT.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Turn-In Manager
Description: Turns in gear for Grand Company seals with guardrails: never items in a gearset, a maximum item level, rarity (green/blue) and HQ/NQ filters, optional armoury chest. Retrieves materia from qualifying gear first (gear turned in with materia loses it). Before seals would cap, it buys items you choose up to a stock target (e.g. Ventures up to 65,000), then keeps delivering. Preview shows exactly what would be turned in. Uses vnavmesh to walk, and Lifestream (if installed) to travel to your Grand Company. English client.
Punchline: Grand Company expert delivery with guardrails, materia retrieval first, and seal spending by stock targets.
